title: Hide and Seek
hook: Peppa 和 George 在客厅玩捉迷藏，可 George 每次躲起来都会发出声音。

cells.q: What game were Peppa and George playing?
cells.a: They were playing hide and seek in the living room.
He hid under the little table. Peppa counted to ten.
cells.cn: 他躲在小桌子底下，Peppa 数到十。

cells.q: Whose turn was it to hide next?
cells.a: It was Peppa's turn to hide. George had to count.
cells.cn: 轮到 Peppa 躲，George 来数数。

cells.q: What did George have to do?
cells.a: He had to find where Peppa was hiding.
cells.cn: 他得找出 Peppa 躲在哪里。

cells.a: He heard that strange noise again and looked around.
cells.cn: 他又听见那个奇怪的声音，四处张望。

cells.a: He thought George should have another turn.
cells.cn: 他觉得应该让 George 再来一次。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig tell George?
cells.a: He asked, “Have you thought of looking upstairs?”
cells.cn: 他问：“有没有想过去楼上找找？”

cells.q: Was Peppa in the toy basket?
cells.a: No, she was not in the toy basket.

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig say at the end?
cells.a: He laughed and said, “That was a good place to hide!”
cells.cn: 他笑着说：“那真是个好地方！”

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: hide, seek, turn, count, upstairs, basket
helper.actions: hide, count, look, find, laugh, ask

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Hide and Seek”.
ending: In the end, Peppa hides in a very good place. My favourite part is ______.
